propositions: git fetch and push call sites in gerrit_client.py and workspace.py lack explicit timeout parameters and can block indefinitely on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers
unbounded git operations on network calls can cause multi-hour hangs, as proven by the 2.1-hour materialization hang in bug 747f

subprocess.TimeoutExpired exceptions in gerrit_client.clone_change_ref bypass the existing token-redaction handler, creating a credential-disclosure vulnerability where user:token@host URLs appear in error messages
ref_lock.py already enforces bounded timeouts structurally through a required timeout keyword-only parameter and does not require modification
init.py and fsck_repair.py network git sites are deferred to task 983f-ee85-1e06-428e pending resolution of bug 01e8
git archive does not exhibit the sequential per-object fetch degradation of read-tree/checkout-index pairs and therefore does not require timeout bounding
